title: Sync the shared AtlasNG workspace files
description: Keeps the shared editor, git hook, AI and nx.json configuration in sync. Nx runs it through nx sync and reads the options from nx.json sync.generatorOptions['@atlasng/nx-plugin:sync']; options passed here take precedence.

prefix.description: Angular selector prefix used in the managed files. Defaults to the nx.json generator prefix, or app.

exclude.description: Managed-file ids or paths to leave alone, for example nvmrc or .github/instructions.

extraScopes.description: Commit scopes added to the Nx project names in .vscode/settings.json, for example release.

skipFormat.description: Do not format the changed files.
